component.name: LegendsOnLinux
component.summary: Play Minecraft Legends (Windows edition) on Linux

description.p: LegendsOnLinux downloads Minecraft Legends from Microsoft for an account that owns the Windows edition, and runs it with a patched WineGDK engine. It signs the game in to Xbox Live and keeps its saves on this computer.
You need to own Minecraft Legends for Windows. The launcher does not distribute any game files. It is not affiliated with Microsoft or Mojang.

Privacy fixes: the sign-in folders are now private to your user, and signing out of Xbox Live also removes the game's copy of the token. The README documents what each sign-in does and where its data is kept.
AppImage. Smaller packages: unused Qt networking is no longer bundled.
Flatpak. The Debian package now shares the Flatpak's PySide6 pruning.
First version: command-line launcher and launcher window.
